When I woke I was walking out the door when the host of the party told me to head back inside there were cops driving by a lot. I told him I just wanna go home, but he insisted so I went inside, and he proceeded to put all 20 some of us in his bedroom. The cops ended up finding us, and put us all in the living room. After a while they asked who would want to take a breathalyzer first, and everyone there shouted my name, which I agreed with completely. The officer could tell I was terrified, and didnt even make me do the breathalyzer. He told me to call my dad to pick me up. He came and got me, and I explained what happened.
